description: Send a text from one of the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx numbers: to (one number or a list of up to 100, E.164), text (up to 1,600 characters), media (up to 10 pictures for an MMS: a Library id, attachment://N or an https link), from (needed when the account has several numbers), sendAt (ISO time, to schedule it; on Twilio this needs a Messaging Service set with set_sms_settings). The answer has each message's id, segment count and status; delivery status follows (get_sms_status). Any optional sending settings the connection turned on (quiet hours, opt-out list) apply. On the brand's own account no credits (the provider bills it); on Hermoso phone 0.8 credit a segment, 2.5 an MMS. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

recipientTimezone.description: IANA zone, only used by quiet hours when the number does not tell it
